ARTICLE XVII
NATIONAL CONGRESS
SECTION 1. National Congress. The two-day Philippine Eagles National Congress shall be held on the 3rd Saturday and Sunday of November of each year at such place to be determined and approved by the National Assembly.
SECTION 2. Objectives of National Congress.
A. The National Congress shall be a yearly gathering of all Regions, Eagles Clubs, Eagle-members and other official guests, as far as practicable, throughout the Philippines and other countries where there are affiliated Eagles club as a venue on “getting together and fellowship”.
B. The gathering of the members of the National Assembly for purposes of:
i.

Submission of reports on the accomplishments of the National Assembly;

ii. Submission of list of enacted National Assembly Acts and Adopted National Assembly Resolutions; iii. List of pending but urgent measures that should be given prioritization in the succeeding session of the new National Assembly; and iv. Such other reports that the National Assembly may deem necessary for guidance of the new members of the National Assembly.
SECTION 3. Highest Consultative Body. The National Congress shall be the highest consultative body of the Philippine Eagles. The National Congress, once convoked and convened, shall act as a consultative body presided by the National President, to consider subjects and matters of general concern to the Philippine Eagles, Regions, Eagles Clubs, in particular and the Eagle-members, in general. The matters

--- Page 180 ---
discussed and deliberated in the National Congress shall be referred to the National Assembly for appropriate legislation or remedial measure, as may be necessary.
SECTION 4. The Executive National Vice President (ENVP) as the Overall Chairman of the National Congress. The Executive National Vice-President (ENVP) shall be appointed by the incumbent National President not later than July of each year to be the Overall Chairman of the National Congress. As the Overall Chairman, he shall have overall charge, supervision and direction of the National Congress affairs, except as provided in Section 6 of this Article pertaining to the National Elections.
SECTION 5. Main Agenda of the National Congress. – The Main Agenda of the National Congress are the following:
a. National President’s Report containing the State of the Philippine Eagles Address (SOPEA);
b. Secretary General’s Report;
c. National Treasurer’s Report containing a detailed financial statement;
d. Reports of the Committees, Philippine Eagles Commissions and other bodies;
e. Bidding for the hosting of the next year’s National Assembly; and f.

Awards and Recognitions on Outstanding Eagle-Members, Eagles Clubs, Regions, National Officers and individual who contributed to the furtherance of the goals and objectives of the Philippine Eagles and helped in the implementation of programs and projects, pursuant to Article XI hereof.

SECTION 6. Holding of National Elections on National Congress. - The National elections in the Philippine Eagles shall be generally held on the last day of the National Congress unless there is force majeure.

--- Page 181 ---
a. The National elections shall be under the direction and full control of the Philippine Eagles Elections Commission based on the election rules and guidelines that PhiEleCom will be promulgated and submitted to the National Assembly not later than the 3rd regular session of each Eagle Year.
b. The delegates to the National Congress for purposes of the national elections are the duly elected delegates of chartered and affiliated Regions for the succeeding Eagle Year, namely:
i.

Regional Governors

ii. Vice Governors iii. Three National Assemblymen per region, or in the absence of any National Assemblymen, the alternate National Assemblymen shall elect among themselves who shall replace the absentee National Assemblymen.
c. The duly elected delegates as mentioned above shall elect among themselves from the list of qualified candidates the following:
i.

Board of Trustees

ii. The National President iii. The Executive National Vice-President iv. The National Vice-President for Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao
v. All other National Officers who are prescribed to be of elected, such as the three (3) members of ApCom
d. The term of office of the above mentioned national officials in paragraph (c) is for two (2) years, commencing on January 1 of the succeeding year, without the right for re-election for the same position wherein he is elected and occupied.

articles.content:
--- Page 187 ---
ARTICLE XX
AMENDMENTS
SECTION 1. Manner and Form of Amendments.
a. Any amendment of the provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 shall be clear and specific.
b. The amendment shall be appropriately and chronologically stated. Thus, any amendment shall be referred to as amendment to the Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024.
c. The amendment shall specify clearly the particular provision of the Section, Article sought to be amended, if any. Or even of the entire Article, Chapter, Section or Paragraph of this Philippine Eagles Constitution that seeks to be amended, the same procedure shall be followed.
d. The amendment shall specify the words as contained in the Article, Chapter or Section sought to be amended, and the proposal in lieu of the words to be amended.
SECTION 2. Procedure and Vote Needed for Amendments.
i.

Amendment to any of the provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution shall be made in accordance with the amendment provisions prescribed in this Article where the amendment shall have been sought.
If no amendatory procedure shall have been provided in this Article, the provisions of the succeeding paragraph hereof shall be applicable.

ii. No provisions in any of the Article in this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 shall be amended except by a twothirds (2/3) affirmative vote of those present members of the National Assembly called for such purpose: Provided, That, as much as possible or practicable, each of the member of

--- Page 188 ---
the National Assembly shall have been furnished a copy manually or electronically of the proposed amendment or amendments, within reasonable period of time prior to the session called for the purpose.
SECTION 3. Referral of the Proposed Amendments. Any propose amendment in this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 shall be initially referred to the Committee on Rules and Constitutional Amendments of the National Assembly.
The Committee will make the necessary review on the amendment before presentation to the National Assembly.
SECTION 4. Referral of Major Amendments or Revision of the Philippine Eagles Constitution. Any major amendments or revision of the Philippine Eagles Constitution shall be referred to the Philippine Eagles Constitutional Commission (PECC) composed of PENAPLE, PEIL, National officers, BOT, RGL and Chairpersons of the Committee on Rules and Constitutional Amendments; and Committee on Judiciary Revision of Codes and Laws, respectively.

articles.summary: ARTICLE XXI TRANSITORY PROVISIONS SECTION 1. Mandate to All Eagle Members on Effectivity and Implementation of the Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024. - The provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 which are necessary, ordinary, and usual to the day-to-day op...
articles.content:
--- Page 189 ---
ARTICLE XXI
TRANSITORY PROVISIONS
SECTION 1. Mandate to All Eagle Members on Effectivity and Implementation of the Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024. - The provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 which are necessary, ordinary, and usual to the day-to-day operations, activities, and conduct of the Philippine Eagles in general, the National Assembly, Executive, Supreme Tribunal, PENAPLE, PEIL, RGL, Philippine Eagles Commissions, Standing Committees, Eagles Regions and Eagles Clubs in particular, are enforceable immediately upon the ratification of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024, except those provisions and mandates which are provided herein in this Article.
SECTION 2. Mandate to the National President. - For the effective implementation of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024, the National President is mandated to:
a. Coordinate with PECC and cause the publication of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 which shall be distributed initially to all duly affiliated Eagles Region and other national officers, free of charge for proper dissemination and compliance. Thereafter, the publication of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 will be printed and mandatorily availed of all Eagle members at cost, the amount of which will be determined by a Select Committee created for this purpose and such amount shall be approved by the National Assembly. Provided, That, in no case, the amount will be lowered than Four Hundred Pesos (P400.00), the amount paid for each copy of the Magna Carta of 1989.
The determination of the cost shall take into consideration the quality of printing, consumer price index, inflation and cost of similar products: Provided, Finally, That any amount to be earned, shall be deposited in a separate account and will only be used to purchase the Eagles nest for TFOE-PE, Inc or

--- Page 190 ---
on similar big project to be deliberated upon by the Board of Trustees and confirmed by the National Assembly.
b. Instruct the Secretary General and other national officers to issue corresponding Executive circulars, directives, memoranda or other issuances for the proper implementation of the provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024.
c. Instruct the PECC in coordination with PEIL for the education information campaign and seminar on the provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024. Attendance on said education campaign and seminar shall be properly prescribed including the corresponding module and other requirements.
d. Lead in the proper implementation of the tenets of the provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 such as proper observance in protocol, procedures, oath of office, appointments to national positions and all acts which are consistent with this Philippine Eagles Constitution.
SECTION 3. Mandate to PENAPLE. - As the official and highest advisory body of the Philippine Eagles PENAPLE is mandated to:
a. Be the guardian in the proper implementation of the provision and tenets of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 through consultation and dialogue in Eagles Clubs or Regions during induction, chartering and other official activities of the Philippine Eagles.
b. Help in the formulation of the forms or necessary National Assembly resolutions or bills needed in the proper and full implementation of the Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024.
c. Give paramount consideration in the furtherance of the goals and objectives of the Philippine Eagles.

--- Page 191 ---
SECTION 4. Mandate to PEIL – The Philippine Eagles Institute of Leadership (PEIL) being the educational arm of the Philippine Eagles is mandated to:
a. Within two (2) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 shall prescribe the necessary and required forms as provided in Article XVIII hereof.
b. Within six (6) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles of 2024 shall formulate the necessary seminars or trainings herein and the primers that will serve as guide to Eagles Clubs and Regions, in particular and that of the TFOEPE, Inc, in general.
c. Within three (3) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 shall formulate a New Protocol Manual, which shall be consistent with the provision of this Philippine Eagles Constitution and must incorporate accepted rituals, protocols as well as recent developments.
Provided, That, the draft of the Protocol Manual will be presented first to PECC for comments and to the National Assembly for approval.
d. Within three (3) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 shall prescribe the correct and proper paraphernalias of the Philippine Eagles in accordance with Article XIII of this Constitution such as i) Charter Grant ii)
Eagles Club and Region banner iii) Gong and Gavel iv) Mace and v) Other protocol and forms which the PEIL may deem necessary in compliance with the provisions said Article.
SECTION 5. Mandate to the National Assembly. - The National Assembly being the highest policy making body of the Philippine Eagles is mandated to:
a. Pass the necessary National Assembly Acts or resolutions, consistent with the provisions of this Philippine Eagles

--- Page 192 ---
Constitution of 2024 in order to provide details on i) New Omnibus Philippine Eagles Elections Code ii) Matters on Membership transfer, activation, Good Standing and the likes to be sponsored by the Commission on Membership and Extension (COMEX) iii) Grounds for Removal from office of Elected and Appointed Officials iv) Creation of the Philippine Eagles Academy v) Needed Primers and Manuals vi) Rules on Lifetime Membership and proper compliance on renewal of membership vii) Establishment of Judicial Conduct Board relative to the impeachment of the members of the Supreme Tribunal viii) And other acts on resolutions it may deem necessary for the immediate and proper implementation of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024.
b. Within two (2) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 shall prescribe the proper forms on i) Proposed National Assembly Bill ii) Proposed Natural Assembly Resolution iii) Proposed National Assembly Act iv)
National Assembly Adopted Resolution v) National Assembly Committee Report vi) Minutes of the National Assembly and Standing Committees vii) Notice of National Assembly Session viii) Other forms and documents it may deem necessary in compliance with Article VIII of this Philippine Eagles Constitution.
SECTION 6. Mandate to the Board of Trustees – The Board of Trustees pursuant to Article III of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 is mandated to:
a. Within a month from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024, cause the submission of a copy of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) including the minutes of the National Assembly of its ratification and other documentary evidence with the end in view of presenting compliance to the provisions of RA No. 11232, otherwise known as the Revised Corporation Code of the Philippines and other SEC issuances.

--- Page 193 ---
b. Within two (2) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution shall adopt its own Rules of Procedures consistent with the provisions of RA No. 11232 and other SEC issuances.
c. Within three (3) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution shall issue and adopt its own Corporate Governance Manual in conformity with the provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024, RA No. 11232 and other SEC issuances.
d. The BOT Rules of Procedures and Corporate Governance Manual as mentioned in paragraphs (b) and (c) hereof shall be submitted to the National Assembly for approval. The approved BOT Rules of Procedures and Manual will be used by the BOT pursuant to the provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution and that of RA No. 11232.
SECTION 7. Mandate to the Philippine Eagles Standing Committees and Philippine Eagles Commissions. - All Chairmen of the Philippine Eagles Standing Committees of the National Assembly in conformity with Article VIII and that of the Philippine Eagles Commissions and Special Eagles Commission created pursuant to Article XI of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 are mandated to submit within two (2) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution: a) A copy of their own Rules or Procedures, By-Laws, if any, to the PECC for review and comments with the end in view of reviewing consistency and compliance with the provisions of this Constitution; b) Compliance to all forms and protocols on gong and gavel, banner, among others.
SECTION 8. Mandate to the Philippine Eagles Elections Commission.
- Philippine Eagles Elections Commission (PhiEleCom) tasked to implement Article VII of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 is mandated to:
a. Within one month from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 to issue the necessary Rules on the

--- Page 194 ---
elections for EY 2025 taking into account elective positions, qualifications, manner of elections and the clear mandate on the removal of election fee or filling fee per candidate, Eagles Club and Region.
b. Within two (2) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 to draft a new Omnibus Election Code for the Philippine Eagles taking into account provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution and previous ruling and practices: Provided, That, the proposed Omnibus Election Code shall be submitted to the National Assembly for approval.
c. Within three (3) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 to devise ways and means for the computerization or digitalization of the elections in the Philippine Eagles, subject to the approval of the National Assembly.
SECTION 9. Mandate to the All Eagle-members. – Upon its effectivity, all Eagle-members are mandated to comply faithfully to the provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024, pursuant to the solemn oath when they voluntarily and freely applied to be Eagle-members of the Philippine Eagles and affiliated to the TFOE - PE, Inc, without mental reservation or purpose of evasion.
SECTION 10. Mandate to All Eagles Clubs and Regions. - All duly affiliated Eagles Clubs and Regions in the Philippines and in other countries or overseas are mandated to faithfully observe and comply with all the provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 upon its effectivity, except on certain procedures, obligations and protocols as provided herein; to wit:
a. Within one (1) month from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 shall comply with the proper use of letterhead, as provided, Brush script when referring to

--- Page 195 ---
Eagles to a Club or Brush Script when referring to an Eagle member.
b. Within two (2) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 on proper compliance on the size and dimension of i) gong and gavel ii) banner iii) mace iv) and other protocols herein prescribed.
c. Within four (4) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024, all elected and appointed officers of Eagles Club and Regions are enjoined to attend the education information campaign and seminar on Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 and its proper implementation and observance.
d. Within six (6) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024, the provisions of this Constitution must be discussed, cascaded and properly disseminated in all Eagles Clubs and Regions during their General Membership Meetings, Rexecom, and Regional Assembly.
SECTION 11. Mandate to All Candidates for the Elective Position for EY 2025. All candidates for any elective position in the Philippine Eagles for EY 2025 shall within four (4) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 must attend the education information campaign and seminar on this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024. Said attendance is a pre-requisite in the filing of certificate of candidacy: Provided, That, the Commissioners of PECC seeking elective position are exempt from the application of this provision.
SECTION 12. Mandate to Review Jurisdictions of Eagles Clubs and Regions. Within three (3) years but not more than five (5) years from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024, a Select Committee composed of PENAPLE, PEIL, National Assembly representatives, the Executive, Supreme Tribunal, RGL, BOT and

--- Page 196 ---
representatives of Regional Governors in the Philippines and other countries or overseas shall study the geographical jurisdiction of Eagles Clubs and Regions with the end in view of delineating metes and bounds of jurisdiction and to rationalize establishment and chartering of Eagles Clubs and Regions.
SECTION 13. Mandate to Supreme Tribunal. Within three (3) months from the effectivity of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 the Supreme Tribunal is mandated to:
a. Prescribe and publish a Katarungang Pang-Agila that provide the mechanism on how to initiate complaint, hear and decide cases in Eagles Clubs, Regions and Supreme Tribunal taking into consideration conformity with the provisions of this Philippine Eagles Constitution of 2024 particularly on Article IV hereof on Bill of Rights and Obligations of EagleMembers. The said Katarungang Pang-Agila shall be subject to the approval of the National Assembly.
b. Provide guidelines and rules on mediation, conciliation and arbitration in Eagles Clubs and Regions as well as in Supreme Tribunal, subject to the approval of the National Assembly.

qa_presets.query: What are the core principles and motto of the Philippine Eagles?
qa_presets.article: ARTICLE II - NAME AND DECLARATION OF PRINCIPLES
qa_presets.answer: The Fraternal Order of Eagles – Philippine Eagles (TFOE-PE) is founded on the guiding motto **'Deo Et Patria'** (For God and Country) and the fundamental philosophy of **Humanitarian Service**. The Order upholds brotherhood, mutual aid, patriotism, integrity, and active community upliftment as its immutable guiding principles.
qa_presets.citation: Article II, Declaration of Principles (e-Constitution 2024, p. 28)

qa_presets.query: What are the qualifications and rights of an Eagle Member?
qa_presets.article: ARTICLE IV - BILL OF RIGHTS AND OBLIGATIONS
qa_presets.answer: Every Eagle member in good standing possesses the right to equal fraternal protection, freedom of expression within fraternal order decorum, the right to inspect chapter books and records, the right to vote in chapter and regional elections, and due process in any disciplinary hearing. Members are obligated to uphold the Constitution, pay national and club dues, attend assemblies, and exemplify moral dignity.

qa_presets.query: What is the quorum requirement for chapter and assembly meetings?
qa_presets.article: ARTICLE VIII - RULES OF THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY & CHAPTER MEETINGS
qa_presets.answer: For chapter General Membership Meetings (GMM) and official assembly sessions, a quorum consists of a **simple majority (50% + 1)** of members in good standing, unless otherwise specified for constitutional amendments which require a two-thirds (2/3) vote. In the absence of a quorum, the presiding officer may only recess or adjourn.

qa_presets.query: How are national dues and club contributions allocated and audited?
qa_presets.article: ARTICLE IX & XII - REGIONS, CLUBS, DUES AND AUDIT
qa_presets.answer: Annual national membership dues and charter fees must be remitted punctually to the National Treasury through official banking and verifiable digital gateways (with proof of receipt). The National Audit Commission is mandated to conduct annual fiscal reviews. Chapters must maintain transparent financial books, and officers face suspension for unaccounted funds or unremitted collections.
qa_presets.citation: Article IX, Section 6 & Article XII (e-Constitution 2024, pp. 110, 145)

qa_presets.query: What are the grounds and procedures for member suspension or expulsion?
qa_presets.article: ARTICLE XVI - CODE OF CONDUCT & FRATERNAL DISCIPLINE
qa_presets.answer: Grounds for disciplinary action include conviction of a crime involving moral turpitude, non-payment of dues for consecutive quarters without justifiable cause, gross insubordination, acts inimical to the welfare of the Order, and violating fraternal confidentiality. No disciplinary penalty may be imposed without written notice of charges and a formal hearing before the Grievance & Arbitration Committee or Supreme Tribunal.

qa_presets.query: What are the official rules on the Eagle Gong, Gavel, and Insignia?
qa_presets.article: ARTICLE XIII - SEAL, EMBLEM, GONG AND GAVEL
qa_presets.answer: The official colors of the Philippine Eagles are Eagle Blue, Bumblebee Yellow, and Forest Green. The Gong and Gavel represent official authority and may only be sounded by the Presiding Officer during formalized opening, business deliberations, and ritual closing of assemblies. Tampering with or altering the official TFOE-PE circular crest is strictly prohibited.
